metadata.title: TTS with Emotion Editing
metadata.author: groovy
metadata.description: Prompt → Kokoro TTS → Step-Audio-EditX VoiceConvert (emotion / style / paralinguistic) → Normalize → Preview/Save. Apache-2.0. Install kokoro-82m + step-audio-editx from Model Browser. See canvas Notes for edit_type / edit_info values. Cold-machine: first Step run on Apple Silicon bootstraps a Python 3.13 mlx-speech sidecar and downloads ~4 GB weights.

widgets.text:
VoiceConvert edits (step-audio-editx)
Set edit_type + edit_info on the VoiceConvert node.

1) Emotion — edit_type: emotion
   edit_info: happy · angry · sad · fear · surprised · excited · confused · empathy · embarrass · depressed · admiration · coldness · disgusted · humour

2) Speaking style — edit_type: style
   edit_info: whisper · serious · child · older · girl · sweet · exaggerated · ethereal · generous · act_coy · warm · shy · chat · radio · news · advertising · recite · story · vivid · roar · murmur · shout · deeply · loudly

3) Paralinguistic — edit_type: paralinguistic
   Put tags in target_text, e.g.
   [laugh] [sigh] [uhm] [cough] [breath] [chuckle] [Surprise-oh] [Confirmation-en]

Also: speed (faster / slower / more faster / more slower) · denoise · vad · clone (needs target_text)
